subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired, should the token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, Blacksmith builder, and Codex action updates land together as one dependency group?
rationale: The test repair is mechanical, but accepting a grouped replacement of executable actions with access to repository credentials, scanning, and publishing is an owner-level security boundary decision.

options.title: Repair and land together
options.body: Update the assertions, verify the final immutable revisions, and merge the group only after exact-head focused checks and security-owner approval.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, scanning, registry, builder, and Codex actions into smaller pull requests for isolated provenance and behavior review.

options.title: Pause the group
options.body: Wait for a stable Dependabot head or narrower update set before continuing owner review.

recommendation.title: Repair and land together
recommendation.body: Update the assertions, verify the final immutable revisions, and merge the group only after exact-head focused checks and security-owner approval.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the most security-sensitive changed workflows and their guard tests to this team.
